c - What does reaping children imply? - Stack Overflow

stackoverflow.com/questions/58885831/what-does-reaping-children-imply
The purpose of the wait* () call is to allow the child process to report a status back to the parent process. When the child process exits, the operating system holds that status data in a little data structure until the parent reads it. Reaping in that sense is cleaning out that little data structure.
